eligibility: eventTime > inputEligibleAfter, equality ignored; rearm at physically captured-through time, not analysis frontier or publication availability. No busy queue, cross-attempt/cross-target reassignment or observation reuse.

fullTruthSupport: Every MATCH requires exact equality between the complete physical normalized pitch set and frozen expected attack set, not subset support.
safetyGate: All measured dangerous counts zero AND nonzero valid empirical opportunity denominators for mandatory topologies AND no ambiguous attribution. 0/0 is NOT_EVALUABLE, never PASS.
availability: Record event source time, decoded source time, source analysis frontier and publication availability separately. Inference completion never rewrites event identity.
